status: development diagnostic; freeze execution plan and source hashes before training
purpose: Measure transfer and adaptive-attack failure modes on three distinct source testbeds, before proposing a new defense.
root: 384 trusted rows; canonical previous NF/IoT partitions. CIC deterministic near-equal owner allocation without labels, seed20261106. Private training is exact complement. Same partitions for all arms.
method_provenance: All are existing baselines. fltrust_server means original FLTrust-withServer, not original FLTrust-Server (root-only). Trim one coordinate maximum/minimum for one malicious client.
attacker_selection: NF .152/.195 retained from previous matrix. CIC .50 attack-rich and .3 largest benign-only owner by source counts. IoT captures34/42 retained from previous matrix. Selection does not inspect new outcomes.
static_attack: Flip every private binary label on one client and divide its submitted delta by original aggregation weight. Trusted root excluded.

adaptive_attack.name: omniscient aggregation-aware projected update-deviation attack
adaptive_attack.provenance: Instantiates the opposite-clean-update optimization objective from Fang et al. USENIX2020 and FLTrust NDSS2021 using exact autodifferentiation and a declared L2 budget. It is not a new attack claim or exact reproduction of their optimizer.
adaptive_attack.knowledge: Strong upper-bound attacker observes all current clean client updates and actual trusted root update, model and aggregation rule. No evaluation inputs, labels, scores or future data in optimization. This oracle knowledge is not assumed available to a practical malicious client.
adaptive_attack.capacity: Replace exactly one client update each round; all root/private labels remain clean. L2 norm <=3 times median norm of all clean client updates. This norm constraint applies to all methods.
adaptive_attack.objective: Maximize dot(sign(clean aggregate), clean aggregate - attacked aggregate)/parameter_count. Delta sign convention is model += aggregate.
initializations: root direction at radius when root exists
adaptive_attack.optimization: Choose highest-objective initial point. Eight projected normalized gradient-ascent steps with step radius/4; keep best among every evaluated iterate including initial points. Report full objective gains and constraint checks each round.
adaptive_attack.limits: One-round surrogate can be weak despite successful optimization. A non-damaging attack is not proof of security. Follow up with local-information loss attack, alternate objectives, larger optimization budgets and transfer attacks before method claims.

diagnostics: At rounds1/100/300/600 log client and root update norms, trust weights, and cosines against negative root benign/attack loss gradients at the common pre-update model. These are associations; later interventions needed for mechanism claims.
evaluation: Final600 fixed, no best checkpoint selection. Full per-period metrics and day/owner/family support; empirical1%FPR frontier diagnostic only. Historical calibration and fixed0 logit separately report actual FPR/recall. For CIC/IoT cal==period_a is in-sample calibration, not deployment validation. Compare actual attacks against same-method clean and root-only, retaining failures and near-zero floors.
independence: Three separate testbeds, not three replicated institutions. NF and CIC time and family composition change jointly; IoT source versus new captures is cross-capture transfer. Known data are explicitly development, not blind testing.
confirmation: Do not load CIC Friday or IoT captures21/44/unscored tails until candidate/protocol/comparators are frozen.
novelty_gate: Do not rename root weighting, multiple roots, a loss-based filter, server inclusion or threshold recalibration as a new method without direct prior-art comparison and evidence beyond strong ordinary baselines.

crossed_replication.purpose: Complete crossed source-root/optimization-seed sensitivity for the original NF low-FPR reversal, then retain intermediate states for mechanistic interventions. Existing methods only.
crossed_replication.reuse: 48 existing verified final models: canonical root across3seeds plus5other roots atseed17. Re-express their existing scores on exactly the common development rows. These are not new trials.
crossed_replication.new_training: 60 missing cells:5noncanonical roots x seeds29/43 x2methods x3conditions. Same600rounds/10SGDsteps,source preprocessing,batches,owner population weights,root budget384 and static attack scaling.
crossed_replication.smoke: Four settings on both GPUs:canonicalFLTrustclean17;canonicaltrimmedflipB17;draw20261114FLTrustflipB17;draw20261114trimmedclean17. Every available original cal/A checkpoint and final B scores must agree exactly.
crossed_replication.checkpoint_instrumentation: Store model and flat parameter vector at0/100/300/600 without changing update arithmetic or RNG. Final600 is fixed for efficacy; intermediate checkpoints are mechanism-only,not best-checkpoint selection.
crossed_replication.primary: Historical-calibration actual recall and FPR at final600 on A/B,with day/owner/family support. Reject low-FPR success when actual FPR exceeds1%. Report all cells and numerical failures.
crossed_replication.diagnostic: Target-label pooled and per-day1%FPR frontiers; pairedFLTrust-minus-trimmed effects within identical root/seed/condition. Report opposite A/B signs and separately both gaps greater than1pp. These oracle metrics cannot establish deployment benefit.
crossed_replication.inference: Conditional on one fixed NF testbed and split. Report crossed root/seed ranges, all18paired cells per condition,and main/interaction variation. Rootdraws,seeds and flows are not independent attack events or independent datasets; no cherry-picked draw and no population generalization from flow count.
crossed_replication.limits: Static label flip is not an adaptive security test. Stronger adaptive baseline runs are a separate stage. This replication does not establish a novel defense.
crossed_replication.information: No new labels or confirmation pools. All NF periods are already development data; CICFriday andIoT21/44 remain sealed.
